list_projects.title: List Godot projects
description: Lists Godot projects that are available to open
When using --global this includes those registered in the project manager and under the project base path.
Otherwise, this recursively searches in the allowed root paths.

open_godot_project.title: Open Godot project
description: Opens a Godot project in a new Godot editor instance, if it isn't already open

list_open_projects.title: List open Godot projects
list_open_projects.description: Lists the projects currently open in each Godot editor instance

get_mcp_configuration.title: Get the Godai MCP configuration
description: Gets the Godai MCP configuration which can be changed at runtime.
This doesn't include all configuration that can be set via command-line arguments, but only those values that can be updated at runtime.
Use the `set_mcp_configuration` tool to change these configuration values.

set_mcp_configuration.title: Set the Godai MCP configuration
description: Sets the Godai MCP configuration which can be changed at runtime.
This doesn't include all configuration that can be set via command-line arguments, but only those values that can be updated at runtime.
Use the `get_mcp_configuration` tool to see the current configuration values.

godot_path.description: The full path to the Godot 4 executable on your system

project_path.description: The base path where your Godot projects usually live
